name: Diverging Bar
summary: Positive / negative bars around zero or a baseline (peer median) — beat / miss vs. consensus, TSR, variance to budget.
summary_zh: 以 0 或基准值（如同业中位数）为中轴的正负条形图：业绩超预期/不及预期、股东总回报、预算差异。
description_zh: 每个类别一根从 0 出发的条，正值用 pos 色、负值用 neg 色，带符号的数值标签放在条的外端，可排序并以 accent-2 高亮目标公司。baseline 设为 'median' 时条长表示相对同业中位数的超额 / 落后（相对 TSR、相对估值折溢价）。横向适合排名，纵向适合按季度看 beat / miss；zeroLabels 把类别名放在零轴另一侧，形成紧凑的龙卷风式排名。
best_for: 1-year TSR or relative TSR vs. peer median
Variance to budget / plan by business unit
avoid_when: All values share one sign and the level matters (use bar / lollipop)
Before / after levels are needed (use dumbbell)
Cumulative walks between two totals (use waterfall)

value.desc: Signed value (or level compared with the baseline)

highlight.desc: Boolean field marking the target row(s)

baselineExcludeHighlight.desc: Median / mean baseline computed without the highlighted (target) rows

baselineLabel.desc: Zero-line label (default 'Median' / 'Mean' + value when the baseline is not 0)

goodDirection.desc: 'up' | 'down' — which sign gets the pos colour

zeroLabels.desc: Horizontal only: category names at the zero line, on the side opposite each bar

labels.desc: Signed value labels outside the bar ends

valueAxis.desc: Show the value axis and gridlines

refLines.desc: [{value, label, color}] reference lines in value units, dashed in --rk-ref unless a colour is given

highlight.desc: Label value(s) to emphasise in addition to the highlight channel

highlightBand.desc: Tinted row / column behind highlighted categories

format.desc: Value format; defaults to the value field's format (signed automatically)

interactions: Bars grow from zero; smooth re-sort on filter change
